title: Discord desktop data (Flatpak)
whyItMatters: The Flatpak build keeps the signed-in account, server list and message cache inside its sandbox folder, so a native-only check will miss it.
source: Flatpak sandbox permissions: per-app config lives in ~/.var/app/<app-id>/config; Discord's Flathub id is com.discordapp.Discord: https://docs.flatpak.org/en/latest/sandbox-permissions.html
notes: Same lowercase discord profile as the native install, relocated into the sandbox.

cleanup.signOut: In Discord, open the user settings with the cog next to your name and press Log Out, so the session on this computer ends.
steps: Quit Discord from its tray icon.
Uninstall the Discord Flatpak from the App Center or from your Flatpak tool.
Move the folder named in the plan to the Trash and empty the Trash.
cleanup.risk: Removes the signed-in session, the message cache, drafts and downloaded files inside the sandbox. Messages on the servers are untouched.
cleanup.source: Discord Support, How do I log out?: https://support.discord.com/hc/en-us/articles/209572128-How-do-I-log-out
